facts.text: I recently wrote a recipe with the help of AI titled "Nutrient-Rich Hearty Stew".
The "Nutrient-Rich Hearty Stew" recipe serves 6-8.
The recipe includes 1 lb skinless, boneless chicken breast diced, with options to substitute turkey or salmon.
The recipe includes 1 cup cooked lentils, with an option to use canned lentils that are drained and rinsed.
The recipe includes 1 cup chopped kale.
The recipe includes 1 cup chopped spinach.
The recipe includes 1 cup chopped broccoli.
The recipe includes 1 cup diced carrots.
The recipe includes 1 cup diced bell peppers in a mix of colors.
The recipe includes 1 cup chopped tomatoes.
The recipe includes 1 large onion, diced.
The recipe includes 2 cloves garlic, minced.
The recipe includes 1 cup cooked quinoa, with options to substitute brown rice or barley.
The recipe includes 1/4 cup chopped walnuts, with an option to substitute almonds.
The recipe includes 1/4 cup raisins or chopped dried apricots.
The recipe includes 1/2 cup frozen mixed berries such as blueberries, raspberries, or strawberries.
The recipe includes 1 cup low-fat yogurt, with an option for a plant-based yogurt alternative.
The recipe includes 3 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth.
The recipe includes 1 cup fortified plant-based milk or dairy milk.
The recipe includes 2 tbsp olive oil or avocado oil.
The recipe includes 1 tbsp nutritional yeast.
The recipe includes 1/2 tsp ground turmeric.
The recipe includes 1/2 tsp ground ginger.
The recipe uses salt and pepper to taste.
The recipe optionally includes fresh herbs such as chopped parsley, cilantro, or basil.
The recipe optionally includes ground seaweed such as kelp or nori.
The recipe instructs heating olive oil or avocado oil over medium heat in a large pot or Dutch oven.
The recipe instructs cooking diced onion and garlic until softened and fragrant for about 5 minutes.
The recipe instructs cooking diced chicken (or turkey or salmon) until browned on all sides.
The recipe instructs cooking kale, spinach, broccoli, carrots, bell peppers, and tomatoes for about 5 minutes to soften slightly.
The recipe instructs simmering the stew for about 25-30 minutes until vegetables are tender and flavors meld.
The recipe instructs stirring in yogurt (or plant-based alternative) and nutritional yeast after simmering.
The recipe instructs optionally sprinkling in ground seaweed (kelp or nori) for an extra iodine boost.
The recipe instructs garnishing with chopped fresh herbs like parsley, cilantro, or basil before serving.
